description: Encode a byte as two lowercase ASCII hex digits packed in a u16 (high nibble in the low byte)
notes: Real-world idiom (hex dumps, hex encoders) written by us. It is the encoding direction; the existing C entry hex-digit-value parses one digit. clang trunk -O3 -march=skylake computes each digit with a compare and a select between two offsets: 15 IR instructions. Whether a branchless form that handles both nibbles at once is better is unknown.
